claims.text: SHURA also holds Andrew Robinson (2025), 'The Calvine Mystery - The Photographic Analysis of a 35-Year-Old Enigma', presented at the Calvine UFO Mystery 35th Anniversary Research Symposium, Perth & Kinross, 2 August 2025.

The university's institutional repository SHURA holds David Clarke's deposited outputs including 'National Archives Podcasts and Media - MoD UFO archives project 2008-2013' (2018), 'UFO Files at The National Archives' (2018), 'The UFO files: the inside story of real-life sightings' (National Archives, 2009; Bloomsbury, 2012), 'How UFOs conquered the World' (2015), and the Clarke/Fuller/Shough report on aerial phenomena observed near the Channel Islands, UK, 23 April 2007.
